newsitem.title: USA: Global Games says acquires software firm.
newsitem.headline: Global Games says acquires software firm.

text.p: Global Games Corp said Thursday it acquired Interactive Computer Corp, a Minneapolis software firm specializing in multi-player games.
The acquisition was a stock transaction with Global providing a $250,000 inter-company loan, Global said in a statement. ICC becomes a wholly owned subsidiary, Global said.

The companies had a previous agreement under which Interactive developed proprietary software for Global Games' on-line virtual casino game, Global said. Interactive Computer president Michael Newell will remain in that role and add corporate staff responsibilities at Global, Global said.
